nodes.name: after-pack.js
nodes.summary: electron-builder afterPack hook that rebuilds better-sqlite3 native module for the target Electron ABI and copies the rebuilt binary into all standalone resource locations to prevent architecture mismatches.

nodes.name: afterPack
nodes.summary: Main hook entry point that rebuilds better-sqlite3 for the Electron ABI via npx electron-rebuild (with fallback to @electron/rebuild API), then walks standalone resource directories to replace all better_sqlite3.node binaries with the rebuilt version.

nodes.name: walkAndReplace
nodes.summary: Recursively walks a directory tree and replaces any better_sqlite3.node file with the freshly rebuilt binary, logging size changes for verification.

nodes.name: after-sign.js
nodes.summary: electron-builder afterSign hook for macOS code signing that detects real Developer ID certificates and skips ad-hoc signing when present, otherwise performs inside-out ad-hoc signing of native binaries, frameworks, helper apps, and the main app bundle to satisfy electron-updater ShipIt validation.

nodes.name: afterSign
nodes.summary: Main hook that detects real Developer ID signatures via environment variables and codesign probes, then either verifies the existing signature or falls back to inside-out ad-hoc signing of all bundle components.

nodes.name: codesign
nodes.summary: Ad-hoc signs a single target path using the macOS codesign utility; failures are logged but non-fatal to avoid breaking builds on edge-case binaries.

nodes.name: collectFiles
nodes.summary: Recursively collects all files matching given extensions within a directory, skipping .app and .framework bundles since they are signed as units.

nodes.name: collectBundles
nodes.summary: Collects bundle directories (.app or .framework) at a given directory level for ad-hoc signing.

nodes.name: build-electron.mjs
nodes.summary: ESM build script that bundles Electron main and preload TypeScript entry points into JavaScript using esbuild with Node.js target, then resolves standalone symlink issues for electron-builder packaging.

nodes.name: buildElectron
nodes.summary: Cleans and recreates the dist-electron directory, bundles electron/main.ts and electron/preload.ts with esbuild (node platform, external electron module, sourcemaps enabled), then resolves standalone symlinks.

nodes.name: resolveStandaloneSymlinks
nodes.summary: Replaces symlinks in .next/standalone/.next/node_modules with real file copies so electron-builder can package them without broken references.
